The '''Thuris sector''' was in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near the [[Parmic sector/Legends|Parmic sector]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Sakai]] governed the sector. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] assigned an elite [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce]] team, [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], to wage a military campaign against Sakai. The Roughnecks destroyed more than 872,000,000 tons of Imperial equipment, and one of the [[Starship/Legends|ships]], ''[[Reekeene's Retribution]]'', made 1,200 armed attacks against Sakai's forces. However, after one particular multi-ship raid on an Imperial fort in Thuris sector, the ''Retribution'' was infiltrated by Imperial agents and lost.<ref name="SS">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>

During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], rogue Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] hid in the [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela system]]. There he established an [[Rezi Soresh's outpost|outpost]] on a [[Unidentified dead red moon|barren moon]]. After capturing the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] colony vessel [[Endeavor (Arkanian starship)|''Endeavor'']], Soresh used the people on board as hostages to lure the Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to the system in order to [[Project Omega|turn him into his personal assassin]]. Skywalker was [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] for two weeks. Soresh also used a brainwashed spy to lure the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] to the [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. Contacting [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], Soresh ensured the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] would arrive at the same time as the Rebel [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. When the opposing fleets arrived, Soresh [[Battle of the Sixela system|sprung his trap]], launching prototype [[resonance torpedo]]es at the system's [[Blue giant/Legends|Blue giant]] [[Star/Legends|star]]. Skywalker betrayed Soresh and freed his [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|companions]], who participated in the battle until the torpedoes hit the sun and started a chain reaction, forcing the Rebels and Imperials to escape. Soresh was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] near the end of the battle. The system was turned into dust and [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] when the sun went [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]].<ref name="Rebel Force: Uprising">''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''</ref>

Prior to [[137 ABY]], during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], the sector fell under control of [[Darth Krayt]] and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|his Sith Empire]]. The sector was most likely liberated following the death of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and his empire's fall at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
